heading: Government-Issued Identity Document with Photograph
page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Evidence 2" x 2" Photo of you Government-Issued Identity Document Birth Certificate Inspection and Admission I-797 Notice of Action Lawful Status I-693 Medical/Vaccination Record I-864 Affidavit of Support Certified Police and Court Records Form I-508 (if applicable) Form I-566 (if applicable) Form I-612 (if applicable) Principal applicant’s I-485 / Green Card (if applicable) Additional Evidence Review & Submit Government-Issued Identity Document with Photograph Applicants should submit a photocopy of a government-issued identity document (for example, passport (even if expired), driver's license, or military identification document) that has their photograph. File upload requirements Clear and readable. Accepted file formats: JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG, TIF or TIFF No encrypted or password-protected files. If your documents are in a foreign language, upload a full English translation and the translator's certification with each original do
